senses.gloss: मोक्तुकाम मोक्तुकाम, i. e. मोक्तुम्-काम (infin. of मुच्), adj. Desiring to cast, Chr. 41, 22.

मोक्ष् मोक्ष्, i. 10 (properly a denomin. derived from मोक्स्ह), and † i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 1, 5301).
 1. To release, to liberate, MBh. 1, 2084.
 2. † To cast.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pres. अ-मोक्षयन्त्, adj. Neglecting to liberate, Yājñ. 2, 300.
 --With the prep. परि परि, To release, to liberate, Weber, Ind. St. iii. 371, 4, below.
 --With वि वि, To release, to protect, MBh. 1, 7880.

मोक्ष मोक्स्ह् + अ (मोक्स्ह् is an anomal. desider. of मुच्), m.
 1. Untying, Pañc. 109, 9; Megh. 97.
 2. Liberation, Pañc. 109, 11; Chr. 4, 16.
 3. Liberation of the soul from the body and from further transmigration, final beatitude, Man. 1, 114; Pañc. ii. d. 127.
 4. Death.
 5. Acquittance of an obligation.

मोक्षक मोक्स्ह् + अक, adj. and sbst., m.
 1. One who sets at liberty, Man. 8, 342.
 2. A deliverer.

मोक्षण मोक्षण, i. e. मोक्स्ह् + अन, n.
 1. Letting go (shedding of blood), Mālav. d. 62.
 2. Liberation, Pañc. 143, 6.
 3. Squandering.
 --Comp.
मोक्ष-क्रिया- + समाचार मोक्ष-क्रिया- + समाचार, adj. affording a way for liberating, Pañc. 109, 11.
